sourceComment: Badge-split grouping for the Split Dex tab in pkmn-np-editor and for the
Kudzu tracker. Nothing in the build reads this file; it is documentation of
run order that both tools render over the real data.
Keyed on map FOLDER names (data/maps/<dir>), not on the display names in
the design doc, because the two disagree: the hack repurposed vanilla
FireRed maps without renaming the folders. ViridianCity_Gym_Frlg is the
Three Island Gym, TwoIsleGrove_Gym_Frlg is the Two Island Gym,
LavenderWoods1 is Saffron Woods and RockTunnel_* is Relic Passage. 'label'
is the name of the place; 'maps' is what the repo calls it.
Locations are in PROGRESSION order - first place you go first, leader
last. Blaine's weather routes therefore read 15, 14, 13, 12, which is the
Any map not listed still appears in the editor, under Unassigned, and any
trainer no event places appears under Not placed on any map. Neither is
ever dropped. Rewritten 2026-09-27 from Joshua's updated split list.

trainerOverridesComment: A location normally decides a trainer's split. These are the exceptions
that are not a place of their own, where the split therefore has to be
stated per trainer. An override always wins over the map.
'tag' is orthogonal to the split - it marks a trainer as guarding
something, and does not move them.

partsComment: A place that is run across two splits: 'maps' gives a map to ONE location,
its owner, and 'parts' lets a later (or earlier) location take a piece of
that map away from its owner. A part names one map and any of:
trainers   - "all", or a list of TRAINER_ constants battled there
wild       - "all", or wild methods: land, water, rock_smash, fishing
encounters - script labels of static / gift encounters on that map
scripts    - script labels whose level-cap raise or badge belongs here
Whatever no part takes stays with the owner. 'oneEncounter' makes every
encounter a location takes count as a single encounter (either Snorlax).
The Kudzu tracker reads parts. pkmn-np-editor's Split Dex does not yet: it
still files a part's trainers under the location that owns their map.

derivedLocationsNote: Maps splits.json does not name, placed under a split by rule: sameSection (another floor of a named place), adjacent (a door leads to a placed map, levels permitting) or wildLevel (placed by its wild levels alone). splits.json always wins; add a map there to override a placement.
